title: Prime Video releases full trailer for Mike Flanagan's Carrie
gist: Prime Video released the full trailer for Mike Flanagan's six-episode Carrie miniseries reimagining, premiering October 7, with the author remaining skeptical about the need for another adaptation but cautiously willing to trust Flanagan's horror track record given his stated intent to avoid retreading Brian De Palma's 'untouchable' 1976 film.

insights.claim: Mike Flanagan's Carrie miniseries for Prime Video, stretched over six episodes, is explicitly not intended as another straight adaptation of Brian De Palma's 'iconic' and 'untouchable' 1976 film, with Flanagan saying at San Diego Comic-Con he wants the series to be 'a big surprise.'
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Signals Prime Video is betting on creative reinvention rather than nostalgia-driven remake formula for a marquee horror IP, a positioning choice relevant to how the series may perform against expectation-driven vs. surprise-driven audience reception.
insights.quote: Carrie was adapted spectacularly by Brian De Palma. It is iconic. It is untouchable. There is no reason whatsoever to try to follow in those footsteps
insights.locator: Flanagan said at San Diego Comic-Con

insights.claim: The Carrie miniseries reframes the story with Carrie White depicted as having been homeschooled her whole life and unequipped to deal with the realities of a contemporary 2020s high school, updating the original novel's bullying and 'first period' plot beats for a modern audience.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Confirms the adaptation's core narrative delta from the source material (homeschooling backstory), the concrete evidence for how it differs from prior versions despite the trailer offering few other surprises.
insights.locator: the new trailer fleshes out the basic premise

insights.claim: Carrie premieres on Prime Video on October 7, 2026, starring Summer H. Howell as Carrie White with a large ensemble cast including Samantha Sloyan, Matthew Lillard, Katee Sackhoff, and Heather Graham.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: A concrete release date and cast list gives a firm near-term content catalyst for Prime Video's fall programming slate.
insights.locator: Carrie premieres on October 7 on Prime Video.

insights.claim: The author expresses lingering skepticism about the necessity of a new Carrie adaptation stretched over six episodes, questioning what story remains untold, but is willing to extend Flanagan the benefit of the doubt given his strong track record with Stephen King-adjacent Netflix horror projects.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: A reviewer's tempered, track-record-based optimism rather than genuine excitement is a useful expectation calibration ahead of the October 7 premiere and subsequent critical reception.
insights.quote: I’m still not completely sold, but I’m also still willing to give Flanagan the benefit of the doubt. He’s got a helluva track record.
